title: Pro-etale sheafification for CommRing coefficients
statement: For every scheme W in universe u [def-pc-scheme], sheaves of commutative rings with underlying sets in universe u+1 on the small pro-etale site of W admit a left adjoint to their inclusion into presheaves [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. This is a specialized proof instance of the existing Mathlib concrete sheafification theorem.

source.place: Sheafification adjunction, Tags 00W1 and 00WH; concrete plus-plus implementation in Mathlib Sites.LeftExact.

proof.text: The pro-etale site cover types are small in the coefficient universe. The forgetful functor for CommRingCat preserves the required limits and filtered colimits and reflects isomorphisms. Apply the concrete plus-plus sheafification instance of Mathlib Sites.LeftExact and project its sheafification adjunction to HasWeakSheafify. The theorem is a proposition; the specialized instance changes no chosen object.
